# Ordinary Fella's

> Ordinary Fella's builds websites and mobile apps, and automates back-office work for
> businesses that need a partner who ships.

## Services

- Web Development — Next.js / React marketing sites and web apps.
- Mobile Development — cross-platform iOS and Android apps.
- Robotic Process Automation — automating repetitive back-office work.
